verdict.rationale: Trivy's CLI is designed for headless, scriptable runs (exit codes, JSON output) that integrate easily into CI/CD pipelines and cron jobs, and it now ships an official MCP server letting AI agents invoke scans programmatically. However, Trivy itself has no built-in scheduler or agent orchestration—'autonomous background' operation depends entirely on external automation infrastructure (CI, cron, or an agent framework) wrapping the tool.
